prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic cinematic fashion-film street editorial at golden hour. An adult woman with shoulder-length voluminous wavy hair and natural glowing makeup walks forward through modern urban architecture with clean geometric lines and open space. She wears a contemporary tailored blazer layered over a fitted knit top and wide-leg trousers with subtle statement accessories. Relaxed but powerful runway posture, chin lifted, light wind moving her hair and outfit edges, premium fabric texture, a low-to-mid angle 35mm tracking view, balanced composition, sharp focus on the subject, and a recognizable softly blurred city background.
